page.notes: Page is a two-column-plus index; the text is set in small type with dot-leader-free right-hand page numbers. Some entries are partly illegible at the gutter and column edges; several Latin readings are approximate, especially the ACTA and ROMANOS entries and the verse numbers at column tops (e.g. "11.b", "16.b" at the top of the right column). The left column top entry "Hæc est condemnatio" and some numerals may be misprinted.
